verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Superset lets users pick which CLI agent to run, such as Claude Code, Codex, Amp or Gemini. Nothing in the pack documents an automatic model-selection mode, or any control for overriding it with a specific model. Choosing an agent is a related but different control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice
